attchmntText: HBL Engineering Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: HBL Engineering Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The auditor issued an unmodified opinion. For the quarter, sales were 862.94 crores, up from 619.54 crores in the previous quarter. Net profit for the quarter was 178.46 crores, compared to 105.47 crores previously. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, sales were 1482.48 crores. Net profit for the half year was 283.93 crores. Earnings per share were 6.44 for the quarter and 10.25 for the half year. The company received 13.66 crores in compensation from the Government of Telangana for land acquisition. Tonbo Imaging India Limited shares listed on exchanges on October 23, 2026.
